name: The St. Regis Riyadh
positioning: The first St. Regis in Saudi Arabia, set inside Via Riyadh in the city's diplomatic quarter, with 24/7 butler service and a spa with separate male and female thermal areas
best_for: Travelers who want a base inside Via Riyadh, with designer boutiques, restaurants and a cinema complex on the doorstep
Guests who enjoy St. Regis rituals such as afternoon tea in the Astor Library and the evening Sabrage
Spa-goers looking for thermal areas with a snow shower and an ice fountain

facts.text: The hotel is in Riyadh's diplomatic quarter, close to King Abdulaziz Historical Center and Al-Masmak Fortress.
Via Riyadh is wrapped within monumental sandstone walls at the edge of the Diplomatic Quarter.
The hotel is cast from ancient Tuwaiq mountain stone.
The interiors, inspired by La Dolce Vita, were designed by the studio of Kristina Zanic.
The hotel has 24/7 personalized butler service.
The 225-square-metre Royal Suite has two bedrooms with walk-in wardrobes, a separate lounge, study, bar and dining area.
In the St. Regis Suite, a sliding wall reveals a marble-clad bathroom with a standalone bathtub and separate rainfall shower.
Rooms have gold-lined tea and coffee cups.
The hotel offers twice-daily turndown service and 24-hour private dining.
Stella Sky Lounge has an open-air terrace where guests can explore shisha.
Afternoon tea is served in the Astor Library.
At Jackie, a gallery of black and white photographs from the 50s and 60s decorates the staircase up to the mezzanine.

highlights.text: The St. Regis Riyadh sits inside Via Riyadh, a mall of designer boutiques, restaurants and a cinema complex.
The hotel is the first St. Regis in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
The spa has separate male and female thermal areas with a traditional sauna, herbal steam room, snow shower, ice fountain and heated lounges.
Jackie celebrates the Kennedy Onassis dynasty with American cuisine infused with Mediterranean warmth, served all day.
The signature Bloody Mary is served alcohol-free for the kingdom.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
King Khaled International Airport is approximately 45 km from the hotel.
The heated swimming pool is not lifeguarded.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: The St. Regis Riyadh
